name: 2026 Australasia Meeting of the Econometric Society (ESAM 2026)
organizer: Econometric Society; hosted by the School of Economics, Adelaide University
deadline_note: Submissions closed 10 July 2026, extended to 17 July 2026. Call closed.
submission_requirements: Papers submitted electronically in PDF format via Oxford Abstracts; submitter must be a member of the Econometric Society
registration_fee: Early bird (17 Aug-8 Sep 2026): US$600 ES members / US$1,000 non-members / US$300 student members / US$600 student non-members; regular (9 Sep-20 Nov 2026): US$700 / US$1,100 / US$450 / US$750. Presenter and early-bird registration deadline extended to 15 Sep 2026.
membership_required: Submitters must be Econometric Society members
keynotes: Larry Samuelson (Yale; Presidential Lecture); Jean-Marc Robin (Sciences Po; Griliches Lectures); James Robinson (Chicago; Sir Leslie Melville Lecture); Isaiah Andrews (MIT; Colin Clark Lecture); Jiti Gao (Monash; E.J. Hannan Lecture); Melissa Dell (Harvard; Maureen Brunt Lecture); Melanie Morten (Stanford; Helen Hughes Lecture); Hilde C. Bjørnland (BI Norwegian Business School; A.W. Phillips Lecture)
